# `ui` — the Diorama UI agent plugin

Agent skills for building with [`@bydiorama/ui`](https://github.com/bydiorama/ui):
apps, Paper designs, and demo videos and stills of the UI. Claude shows each
skill as `ui:<skill>`.

| Skill | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `ui:app-motion` | Adding motion to an app built with @bydiorama/ui — who owns which animation, how to bring in transitions.dev snippets for product interactions without breaking their licence, and the integration traps (one snippet per element, nested accordions, digit swaps, replay, JS timing, reduced motion). |
| `ui:craft` | Craft rules for building interfaces with @bydiorama/ui. |
| `ui:demo-page` | Build a live, animatable front-end page from a Diorama screen design — real interactions with transitions.dev snippets, a scripted looping walkthrough, per-component snippets, light/dark modes and composition framing — ready to be captured as video or stills. |
| `ui:design-component` | Designing a component in Paper against the Diorama design system — every state, every size, both colour schemes — before anyone implements it. |
| `ui:effects` | Applying @bydiorama/ui's effects layer — glass, grain, sheen, glow, shimmer, ink, and the optional shaders: the parametric gradient ground and halo — to components in a consumer app. |
| `ui:motion-media` | Entry point for turning a Diorama UI design into presentation media — an animated front-end demo, looping 60fps videos, component snippets, compositions and static stills for articles, decks and social. |
| `ui:static-rendering` | Using @bydiorama/ui in static or server-rendered frameworks — Astro, SSR, static export — where React components ship as HTML and only some hydrate. |
| `ui:stills-render` | Render static, lossless 2× PNG stills of a scripted UI demo — one per video, frozen at the moment that best tells its story, framed exactly like the clip (60% width, dim and vignette, or dotted-ground composition) with the cursor hidden. |
| `ui:video-render` | Render a scripted UI demo page into smooth, seamless-looping 60fps videos with Playwright and ffmpeg (Node scripts, or a Python port for machines without Node) — full walkthroughs, component snippets framed at 60% width with dim and vignette, and dotted-ground or full-view compositions in light and dark, landscape and portrait. |
| `ui:visual-review` | Comparing a screen built with @bydiorama/ui against its design pixel by pixel — exporting 1× references of frames and components, reproducing the exact state with a script, diffing on a canvas in the same browser and reading the result. |

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add bydiorama/ui
/plugin install ui@diorama-ui
```

claude.ai and Cowork: **Customize › Plugins › Add › Add marketplace**, enter
`bydiorama/ui`, then add the `ui` plugin. The plugin has no version
number, so it follows `main`; turn on automatic updates for the
`diorama-ui` marketplace.

If an app still has skills the CLI copied in (`.claude/skills/diorama-*`),
delete them and their entries in `ui.lock.json`, so the two copies don't compete.

## Changing a skill

Never here. The source is `registry/skills/<skill>/` in bydiorama/ui; this
folder is regenerated by `pnpm skills:build` and `pnpm check:skills` fails on
drift. The `create-skill` skill in that repo has the rules.
